record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: GULPIN (1 star) and SWALOT (2 stars), the queued units.
record.summary: Three-way ability driven by the caster's cast counter count.ult, which the base process has ALREADY incremented for this cast (first cast sees 1). (1) If HP < 25% of maxHP and count.ult > 0: 'swallow' - heal table[count.ult]% of maxHP (20 / 40 / 60 for counter 1 / 2 / 3, requested), through handleHeal with apBoost 1 and the cast's crit flag, then count.ult = 0 (reset even if the heal was blocked). (2) Else if count.ult >= 3: 'spit up' - SPECIAL damage 40 (GULPIN, 1 star) / 80 (SWALOT, 2 stars) to each entity of a different team in the three cells in front of the caster (facing the cast target), then count.ult = 0. (3) Otherwise 'stockpile' - the caster gains +3 DEF and +3 SPE_DEF (code value; the source comment says 1). Without low HP the cycle is therefore: cast 1 stockpile, cast 2 stockpile, cast 3 spit up, counter back to 0. The RECOVER and SWALLOW references in the file are animation broadcasts only; no other ability strategy is executed.

targeting.who: heal and stockpile: the caster; spit: entities of a different team in the three front cells; the cast target is only used to orient the caster and for the base process (requiresTarget true, so the unit must have a target to cast)

geometry.shape: spit branch only: the three cells directly in front (the target-facing orientation and its two neighbouring orientations, one step each), cells off the board dropped
geometry.orientationNote: getCellsInFront overwrites pokemon.orientation from the caster-to-target offset; same position gives a random orientation when confused, otherwise an error log and DOWNRIGHT

effects.target: the caster (branch 1, HP < 25% maxHP and count.ult > 0)

declaredRaw.note: requested heal as a share of the caster's maxHP; count.ult at the branch is the already incremented value (1..3 in practice, since it resets at 3), so 20 / 40 / 60 percent; index 0 (0%) is unreachable because count.ult > 0 is required

effects.scaling: handleHeal(heal, pokemon, 1, crit): x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost 1), x critPower if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT), BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3, burn x0.5, enraged x0.5, Zenith weather x1.2, then Math.round
effects.resolution: shared handleHeal rules (core-mechanics section J): wound -> nothing healed (Blood Moon with Blood Stones requests round(0.3 x stones x heal) through addShield instead); status.protect -> nothing healed (status.runeProtect does not block); otherwise hp += min(missing HP, rounded heal) - the requested amount is the figure above, the applied change is the capped figure, overheal = rounded heal - missing HP and, with the Grass synergy effect, addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal) (not 40% of max HP); the 'swallow' only happens below 25% HP so the cap rarely binds. count.ult is reset to 0 afterwards regardless of the heal outcome

effects.target: each entity of a different team in the three front cells (branch 2, count.ult >= 3 and branch 1 false)

declaredRaw.note: requested amount, raw; GULPIN (1 star) 40, SWALOT (2 stars) 80

effects.scaling: requested x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true) x crit multiplier only if the cast crit; one crit flag for every entity hit
effects.resolution: applied per entity: SPE_DEF division damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef), minimum 1, then later handleDamage modifiers; protect / skydiving / magicBounce block the hit; takenDamage (shield included) is not used. Reached only when branch 1 did not trigger, so a spit never happens while HP < 25% and count.ult > 0

effects.target: the caster (branch 3, neither of the above)

declaredRaw.note: requested +3 each, flat; the source comment says 1

effects.scaling: addDefense / addSpecialDefense with apBoost 0 and crit false: no AP or crit scaling; the value 3 is rounded, Big Eater Belt would give 3 x 1.25 = 3.75 rounded down to 3 (no change for this value), Twist Band does nothing to a positive value, floor 0; permanent is false so only the fight entity changes
effects.resolution: applied change = +3 DEF and +3 SPE_DEF on the caster's combat stats; the counter simply stays incremented (no reset), so the stacks are the count.ult value

starBehavior.note: only the spit damage depends on the caster's stars (indexed pokemon.stars - 1, fallback 300; 150 and 300 are not reached by these units); the heal percentage depends on count.ult, the stockpile values and the thresholds do not depend on stars. maxPP 60 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: Branch choice is by the caster's HP and cast counter, not position. Only the spit uses the board: the target-facing orientation selects the front cells.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: State is count.ult (the caster's own cast counter): +1 at the start of every cast of this unit, reset to 0 by branch 1 and branch 2 only. Cycle without low HP: cast 1 -> counter 1 -> stockpile; cast 2 -> 2 -> stockpile; cast 3 -> 3 -> spit up, counter 0. Branch 1 can interrupt at any point when HP < 25% (the heal is 20% / 40% / 60% for counter 1 / 2 / 3); a spit due at counter 3 is replaced by the 60% heal if HP is low. Counter and branch 3's stat gains are not reset by each other: the +3 DEF/SPE_DEF stay until the fight ends. Another source of casts or a reset (the only other reset found is for VOLT_SURGE) was not found for these units.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested heal 20 / 40 / 60 percent of maxHP by counter; applied = round(requested x modifiers above) capped at missing HP, blocked entirely by wound or status.protect (Blood Moon / Blood Stone may request a shield instead), Grass overheal adds 0.4 x overheal max HP. Requested spit 40 (GULPIN) / 80 (SWALOT); applied per entity after AP, crit, SPE_DEF division (min 1) and later handleDamage steps; takenDamage not used. Requested stockpile +3 DEF and +3 SPE_DEF; applied +3 each (Big Eater Belt rounds 3.75 down to 3). The source comment (+1, 'over 3 stacks') disagrees with the code (+3, counter >= 3 including the current cast); the code was followed.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, canCast, targeting, range)
Crit chance resolution (only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was read)
unresolved: REFERENCES_OTHER_ABILITIES: Ability.RECOVER and Ability.SWALLOW appear only as broadcastAbility({ skill }) arguments (animation requests); no other ability strategy is called. What the client does with the broadcast was not read.

Consulted: SwallowStrategy, AbilityStrategy.process, castAbility, Board.getCellsInFront / orientation, PokemonState.handleHeal and addShield, PokemonEntity.addDefense / addSpecialDefense / handleSpecialDamage, applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff / applyTwistBandBuff, roundToNDigits and core-mechanics section J. Queue record: no dependencies.
OrientationVector / OrientationArray values were not read, so which exact three cells are 'in front' for each direction is not listed here

Whether anything other than the base process (and the VOLT_SURGE reset) changes count.ult for these units was searched by name across app/core and only the entries cited here were found; item or synergy effects that read it were not enumerated beyond that search
Real HP situations (how often HP < 25% happens) and the cast timing were not examined
